title: Huawei, Qualcomm strike multi-year patent agreement across 5G, AI
source_used: Joint Huawei and Qualcomm announcement (Media OutReach Newswire via Macau Business)
key_facts: Huawei and Qualcomm announced a multi-year, broad patent license agreement on 5 Oct 2026.
It includes cross licenses of patent portfolios in 5G, compute, AI and networking.
Qualcomm will also buy certain Huawei US patents in compute, AI, networking and other areas.
The transaction closes after the necessary regulatory approvals.
Both say licensing follows FRAND principles (fair, reasonable and non-discriminatory).
quote_evidence: Huawei and Qualcomm today announced a multi-year, broad patent license agreement that includes cross licenses to the companies' patent portfolios
This transaction will close following receipt of the necessary regulatory approvals.
why_it_matters_hint: Two rivals settle patent access in 5G and AI; regulatory approval still pending.
